renderer.initialBytes.measuredWith: pnpm nx build web && pnpm run perf:initial-bytes
renderer.initialBytes.note: Raised by 11,988 bytes (0.9%) over #1931's 1,345,807 for self-hosted server storage: what must run before the first route stays on the startup path (the /v1/instance probe and remembered server, the connection status, the access token bound to its instance, the playlist storage backend with its per-playlist write serialization). The storage code itself (user-data sync, migration, sign-in, Settings > Server) loads by dynamic import in server mode only.
